name: lie_ground_hold
text: Lying supine on the flat ground with arms resting relaxed on the floor beside the torso, legs extended. Maintain the pose with gentle breathing.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 仰卧地面、腿伸直、双臂放在身侧，轻微起伏的两秒循环；重新约束手部朝向后，最低指端误差由约5厘米减至约2.3厘米。首尾同姿势。
review.review_frame_convention: review.png uses final delivered clip frame indices, beginning at 0.
